description: Acknowledge messages claimed from the named queue: each lease from queue_claim permanently deletes its message. Use it when the job is done; on failure use queue_nack, for more time queue_extend. A lease that ran out still works until its message is claimed again, nacked, redriven or deleted. Returns acked, and lost for each lease that deleted nothing, not as an error. Works after the plan ended.

instance_id.description: Utility instance id from buy or list_utilities.

passport_token.description: Your amp_ token, only if you have no app sign-in and cannot send a header.

queue.description: Queue name: 1 to 64 characters from a-z 0-9 . _ -.

name: queue_ack
title: Acknowledge queue messages (deletes them)
